patterns.note: The hero section features a dynamic video background that transitions between different high-fidelity CGI scenes as the page loads or scrolls, with a central text overlay and CTA appearing over the second video scene.
Content sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds and full-width light backgrounds, creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.
Section headings are large and bold, often appearing in a single line, contrasting with smaller, lighter body text and subtle uppercase labels for categories or dates.
Prominent client and partner logo grids are strategically placed after the hero and within content sections to establish authority and social proof.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero dynamically changes its content or plays a different segment after an initial load, featuring a central, high-contrast text overlay and call-to-action button. The navigation bar remains sticky at the top throughout the scroll.

Sections are structured with generous vertical padding, alternating between dark and light full-width backgrounds to delineate content blocks. Content within these sections often uses flexible grids for cards and images.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3x body) with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for interactive elements like buttons and image cards, otherwise sharp for overall section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and balanced, consistent spacing within content grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its cinematic, high-fidelity video hero that dynamically transitions between striking CGI scenes, immediately conveying the product's advanced capabilities. This visual sophistication is carried throughout the page with polished imagery and a clean, authoritative layout.
